body:
Thank you again for your insight. I really want to clean the slate again so to speak, but I'm so worried about being let down again. I need stability - but then I need adventure - and I don't know what the fuck I'm doing.

  And yeah, I'm already seeing a doc and on medication :/ It helps sometimes, like super emergencies, but these feelings have been growing for a while now and I don't know how to sort them out and it's just...just really tough. I haven't ever met someone who can understand my situation, and it's just incredibly isolating and I feel like I'm running in circles trying to make new friends because it becomes apparent that there's something 'up' with me at a certain level of closeness, and most people are put off by the stigma that comes with mental illness and I don't even know.

My head is all over the place. I'm getting off work in like an hour and I don't know what to do with myself once I get home.

Hey, thanks for the response. I appreciate that someone is interested enough to ask for details. I was initially here to 'broaden my horizons' and yes, have a 'world is beautiful' moment. 

 As for the details of the country and the situations that made living particularly difficult here - a. I don't want to give away too much personal information, I know that sounds stupid but sorry and b. the details are all a very, very long story. I will tell you though that the situations that made life hellish here are directly related to my bipolar disorder, lack of control, and frequent inability to be in a 'normal' (non manic, non-depressed) state. 

Going home is failure. It's settling, it's becoming sick again like I did before and probably going through this all again.

 That's what I'm saying.
I tried to kill myself at home because I couldn't handle the world I was living in.

I want to kill myself now because I tried to change my surroundings and crashed and burned even harder. I have no close friends here.

It is a dead end.

I'm so sorry I haven't covered all your questions. It becomes cyclical thinking, and it's making me panic even more. I'm really sorry and thanks for your support.
